Drawback: Time Limit.name: Drawback: Time Limit
Drawback: Time Limit.description:
⏱️ Your Quirk only holds for a short window at a time.

⚠️ Past that window it drops on its own.
⚠️ The harder you have pushed, the shorter the window gets.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Eijiro Kirishima (Hardening), Himiko Toga (Transform).
Drawback: Time Limit.traitNarrativeEffects: The Quirk stays active only for a short window before it drops on its own. The window is shorter than the family's usual duration and lengthens as the user's Quirk Stamina rises. Quirk Strain 60 (50 for an Exceptional Quirk): the window shortens; the user feels the end coming (tingling, a loosening hold on the effect, a transformation starting to slip). Quirk Strain 80: the drawback is active; sustained effects end at the close of the turn they start, and any use beyond light that runs long collapses early. Quirk Strain 100: the Quirk times out completely: an active effect drops, a transformation reverts, and it will not start again until Strain falls below 60. Ordinary life: the user counts seconds, drills timing, and builds plans that finish inside the window. The signs fade as Strain falls back below each threshold. If the character chose Quirkless, this drawback does not apply: they have no Quirk and never gain Quirk Strain.
